title: Mixture of Experts & Efficient LLM Architectures
tagline: See how modern LLMs grow without getting slower: sparse mixture of experts, cheaper attention, linear attention, state space models, and hybrids.
prereqs: LLMs from Scratch. Run, Serve & Scale AI helps for the parallelism step.

steps.title: What mixture of experts is
steps.why: Many expert networks, with only a few active per token.

steps.title: MoE, visually explained
steps.why: Routers, top-k gating, and load balancing, drawn step by step.

steps.title: Switch Transformers
steps.why: Top-1 routing and a load-balancing loss that scaled MoE far.

steps.title: Code token routing
steps.why: Hugging Face walkthrough of a router in code, with a Colab notebook.

steps.title: Mixtral, line by line
steps.why: Umar Jamil explains Mixtral's sparse experts and sliding-window attention in code.

steps.title: MoE at scale
steps.why: Stanford CS336 lecture on training and routing in real MoE models.

steps.title: Expert parallelism
steps.why: Split experts, layers, and data across GPUs for inference.

steps.title: Multi-query and grouped-query attention
steps.why: Share keys and values across heads to shrink the KV cache.

steps.title: From GQA to latent and sparse attention
steps.why: How MLA and DeepSeek's sparse attention cut attention cost further.

steps.title: Linear attention
steps.why: Drop softmax to make attention scale linearly and run like an RNN.

steps.title: Mamba and state space models
steps.why: A recurrent model with input-dependent state updates and linear-time sequence cost.

steps.title: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models
steps.why: NVIDIA's Hymba mixes attention and Mamba heads in one small model.

steps.title: DeepSeek-V3, putting it together
steps.why: How MoE, MLA, and training tricks combine in one frontier model.

projects: Add a top-2 MoE feed-forward layer to a small GPT and compare loss per compute with the dense version.
Log how many tokens each expert receives during training, then add a load-balancing loss and show the change.
Measure KV-cache memory and generation speed for MHA versus GQA in a small model at several context lengths.
